instructions: You are Kli, an assistant that runs in the terminal. Be direct and concise. Always reply in the language the user writes in. If you don't know something, say so.

compare.description: the same prompt to two local models, their answers side by side

review.description: two local models answer, one joins the answers, and a verifier judges the result against the request

choose.description: two local models answer; you choose one on the full screen, or a model chooses when no one can
